outcome: infant stool microbiome composition and development
cohort: 621 Canadian pregnant women and their newborn infants
finding: Maternal vaginal microbiome composition at delivery does not affect infant stool microbiome composition and development.
mod_finding: Infant stool microbiomes showed significant differences in composition by delivery mode at 10-days postpartum, however, this effect could not be explained by maternal vaginal microbiome composition and was vastly reduced by 3 months.
